title: AMC Yellow Ticket Deals & Snack Combos—Save Up to 38% on Movie Night
description:
Flexible Savings – Redeem discount tickets for any movie at participating AMC Theatres (except CA, NY and NJ)
    
    
      Perfect Gift Deal – No guesswork, just movie magic! A great gift for friends & family.
    
    
      Bulk Discounts – Ideal for rewards, giveaways & corporate gifts
    
    
      Upgrade Your Savings – Add premium experiences like IMAX, Dolby Cinema & AMC Prime! 
    
  

HOW TO CLAIM YOUR TICKET DISCOUNT

  
    
      
        After your purchase
      
    
    
      
      Go to "My Stuff" in your Groupon account, view the voucher and click "Redeem Online"
    
    
      
     You'll be directed to an External Site to enter your email address and claim your discount AMC tickets.
    
    
      
      That's it! You'll receive the tickets in your Inbox.
    
    
      
      Pick your Movie, reserve your seat online or present your AMC Ticket at the box office and Enjoy the show!
    
   
    For the latest showtimes, visit the AMC website or app.
  


THE ULTIMATE MOVIE EXPERIENCE AT AMC
LIGHTS, POPCORN, SAVINGS - ONLY AT AMC!
Premium Quality, Ultimate Comfort – Enjoy stunning IMAX, Dolby Cinema, and AMC Prime visuals with experiential sound and luxurious recliners.
Popcorn Magic – AMC's Perfectly Popcorn™ is popped fresh daily with flavors like Extra Butter, Cheesy Cheddar, and Salted Caramel. Go big with the MegaBag™—three times larger for the ultimate movie snack!
Kick Back & Relax – With plush recliners, reserved seating, and even heated seats at select locations, AMC takes movie nights to the next level!

    
    
    
        
            Fun Fact: AMC is the #1 seller of movie theatre popcorn! Every day, they pop a whopping 35 tons of kernels—enough to fill 52 million bags of buttery, delicious goodness or 222 Olympic-sized swimming pools annually.
       
    


FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What are AMC Yellow Ticket Deals?

  AMC Yellow Tickets are discount movie tickets giving you big-screen entertainment at a budget-friendly price, valid for any standard 2D movie across the U.S.—except in California, New York, and New Jersey. If you're in those states, no worries! AMC Black Ticket Deals offer the same great savings and more, so you can still catch all the action while saving big.

Do AMC Yellow Tickets expire?

You have 90 days to redeem the Groupon voucher online before it expires. Once the voucher is redeemed, there is no expiration date for the AMC Yellow tickets that you receive, use them whenever you like!
